stories.title: Soldier martyred, 17 terrorists killed in intelligence-based operations in Balochistan: ISPR
summary: According to a statement by Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), security forces conducted the IBOs on Nov 1 on the “reported presence of terrorists belonging to Indian proxy Fitna al Hindustan”.

During the operation, “terrorists’ attempt to establish [a] road block in the city was thwarted by proactive action of security forces,“ resulting in the killing of 10 terrorists. “Weapons and ammunition were also recovered,” it added.

The statement added that Sepoy Hikmatullah, who was 25 years old and a resident of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Karak district, was martyred during the IBO. “Sanitisation operations are being conducted to eliminate any other Indian-sponsored terrorist found in the area,” it added.

stories.title: Govt assures public of meeting domestic gas demand during winter, hints at 'good news' for fuel prices
summary: Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik on Tuesday assured the public that the government will make utmost efforts to meet the demand for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) during winters.
His remarks come as LPG supply has been disrupted due to the closure of Iranian border crossings, resulting in gas cylinders being sold at twice the official rate in the open market.
The minister observed that the country was facing “numerous challenges” regarding the availability of LPG.

stories.title: 'We made a deal months ago': Trump says US will stop $4 billion funding to Israel at end of 2026
summary: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he made a deal with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Washington would stop $4 billion in funding to Israel after the end of this year.
Now we’ll help Israel if they need it.” There was no immediate comment from Netanyahu’s office on Trump’s remarks.

stories.title: Americans vote in midterms set to upend Trump presidency
summary: Americans voted on Tuesday in pivotal midterm elections, with Democrats hoping to seize control of Congress and impose the first significant checks on Donald Trump’s chaotic second term in the White House.
Decision Desk HQ’s final forecast forecasted 241 House seats for Democrats against 194 for Republicans, and a narrower 52-48 Democratic Senate majority.

Trump, who will watch the midterms results at the White House on Tuesday night, signalled that if he does lose control of Congress he could simply defy Democrats. “I veto everything,” he told a podcast on Monday, although he said he might strike deals with Democrats eventually.

stories.title: Islamabad ATC grants bail to Imaan, Hadi in police altercation case
summary: ISLAMABAD: An anti-terrorism court (ATC) in Islamabad on Tuesday granted bail to lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, in a case registered against them for allegedly blocking a road outside the National Press Club and engaging in an altercation with police.
The police also produced the case record before the court during the proceedings.
Just a day later, a sessions court sentenced them to 17 years on multiple charges under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act in the controversial social media posts case.

stories.title: CM Maryam incensed at Chaudhry Salik's claims of corruption in Punjab
summary: LAHORE: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz on Tuesday said she would be sending a defamation notice to Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain for levelling allegations of corruption against her government.
Addressing a ceremony in Attock on Tuesday, CM Maryam said: “There is a federal minister … somebody sent me his statement about corruption in Punjab.
Maryam also took exception to Salik’s comments calling Elahi the “best-ever chief minister” in Punjab. “The Gujrat that Pervez Elahi handed me — I went there about two years ago and it was raining.

stories.title: JI and Dar hold 'candid discussions' on fuel relief, agree to continue talks in coming days
summary: The government and Jamaat-i-Islami (JI) on Tuesday held “candid discussions” on practical measures to provide relief to low-income citizens in petroleum prices.

After a meeting with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif last week, both sides agreed to form a bipartisan committee to expand the government’s ongoing fuel relief scheme in response to JI’s demands for the abolition of the petroleum levy.

When PM Shehbaz and Rehman finally met about a month later, they agreed to form a joint committee to recommend proposals for expanding the fuel relief scheme and for a phased reduction in the petroleum levy for the next budget.

stories.title: Entertainer and enigma, Glenn Maxwell bows out as cricket's great what-if
summary: A two-time ODI World Cup winner, Maxwell also hit the winning runs in Australia’s maiden T20 World Cup triumph in 2021 under captain Aaron Finch.

You’ve changed the way the game is played and inspired so many along the way.” T20 royalty Maxwell’s value was always three-dimensional: explosive batting, savvy off-spin, and electric fielding that saved runs and snared jaw-dropping catches.
Maxwell played only seven tests between 2013 and 2017, scoring 339 runs at a modest average of 26.

stories.title: Soaring LPG prices force rickshaw drivers in Pakistan to cut meals
summary: Now, with liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices surging, he doesn’t even make half that.
LPG prices have surged since October 17, when two Iranian border crossings closed, halting imports, traders say, in the latest energy shock since the US-Iran war began in February.

stories.title: Lahore court grants NCCIA further two-day remand of suspects over US postage stamp fraud
summary: LAHORE: A judicial magistrate on Tuesday granted the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) a further two-day physical remand of two suspects in a Rs35 billion fraud involving the online sale of counterfeit US postage stamps.
The Lahore NCCIA announced the prime suspect’s arrest in late October, and he was sent on a five-day physical remand on Oct 21.
According to NCCIA, the initial investigation revealed that the prime suspect operated a website to market and sell over 5m fake US postage stamps over a period of more than three years.

stories.title: IHC grants protective bail to TikToker booked following stampede at wedding event
summary: ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday granted protective bail to TikToker Muhammad Ansar Jatt, alias “Mr Pattlo”, after a stampede at his mehndi (henna) event in Sialkot claimed two lives.

On Tuesday, IHC Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar approved the protective — also known as transitory — bail for the TikToker until Nov 10, allowing him to avoid arrest while he approaches the relevant court to seek legal remedy.
Jatt had filed a petition, seeking the court’s intervention to prevent his arrest before he could reach the court of competent jurisdiction.

stories.title: French judges probe war crimes complaint against Israeli army in Lebanon: lawyer
summary: France has opened a judicial investigation into a war crimes complaint over an Israeli strike on a residential building in Lebanon, a lawyer told AFP on Tuesday.
Several investigations underway While the judicial investigation marks a first over alleged war crimes by Israeli forces in Lebanon, other cases are pending.

The PNAT also asked a Paris judge to open a war crimes investigation into the deaths of two French children in an Israeli bombing in Gaza in October 2023, while ruling out charges of genocide and crimes against humanity, according to sources close to the case.

stories.title: IHC suspends order rejecting FIR plea in Pims fire case, seeks inquiry report and govt response
summary: ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday suspended a Justice of the Peace’s order dismissing an application seeking the registration of an FIR into the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) neonatal fire tragedy.

The court also directed the authorities to submit the complete record, along with the inquiry report, and issued notices to the respondents, including the federal government and the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO).
After hearing the arguments, the court suspended the Justice of the Peace’s order and directed the authorities to submit the complete record, including the inquiry reports, before the next hearing.

stories.title: Petitions against detention of Sohail Afridi, others referred to PHC CJ for constitution of larger bench
summary: PESHAWAR: A Peshawar High Court (PHC) bench on Tuesday referred multiple petitions challenging the detention of PTI leaders, including Sohail Afridi — the non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister — to the chief justice for the constitution of a larger bench.
It further observed that the detentions under consideration were not MPO cases. “This is an important case; the chief minister of the province is missing,” Justice Ali observed.

The bench said the court had given the respondents 10 days to file replies, but they had not complied with the order. “We refer this case to the chief justice to constitute a larger bench,” Justice Ali said.

stories.title: Binance says outflows normalised as North Korea rejects US allegation over heist
summary: Asset outflows from Binance have normalised and the company was in “very strong financial health”, its co-CEO said, as North Korea dismissed as “absurd rhetoric” US allegations that it was behind a $6.3 billion cryptocurrency heist on its platform.
North Korea denies allegations linking it to cryptocurrency theft and other cybercrimes.
Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis estimated 89pc of crypto hack losses in 2026 were linked to North Korea, up from 15pc in 2021.

stories.title: Foreign women rape case: Incomplete police report clears five suspects of sexual assault charges
summary: LAHORE: An incomplete investigation report (challan) filed before a trial court in connection with the alleged gang rape of two foreign women in July cleared five suspects, including one reportedly linked to a senior minister, of sexual assault charges.
However, according to the police report, the women did not pay him any profits or return his investment this time.
Therefore, the police submitted an incomplete investigation report to avoid delays, despite having sufficient evidence against the suspects.

stories.title: Respect for a woman’s dignity not just a matter of personal morality but constitutional obligation: Supreme Court
summary: ISLAMABAD: The Supreme Court (SC) stated on Tuesday that respect for a woman’s dignity was not merely a matter of personal morality but a constitutional obligation the state expected of everyone in its service.

His character, integrity and conduct in private life may also become relevant where these factors bore upon his suitability to hold a public office, the discipline of the service or public confidence in the institution he served, Justice Waheed emphasised.
It is that the petitioner set his wife on fire, an act which, if established, is among the gravest forms of violence one person can inflict upon another,” the judgement said.

stories.title: 2 policemen martyred, 1 injured in attack en route to polio duty in KP's Mohmand
summary: The governor noted that polio workers “perform a national duty to protect children and promote a healthy Pakistan” and said the government was responsible for providing security to polio teams.
In September, two policemen were martyred as armed assailants fired at a polio vaccination team in Balochistan’s Noshki.
Similarly, a police constable was martyred and four others were injured in an attack on a law enforcement party en route to provide security for polio teams in KP’s Hangu in April.

stories.title: Apple shares slide as higher memory costs fuel margin concerns
summary: John Ternus delivered his first ‌earnings report as Apple CEO on Monday, describing the memory-pricing environment as "unprecedented" while expecting costs to rise beyond the quarter ending in December.
Apple expects gross margin for the December-ending quarter to range between 45% and 46%, which also reflects the expenses tied to the ramp-up of its AI-powered ​Siri.

However, Apple reported a record September quarter for iPhone revenue despite price increases and a staggered iPhone release schedule where only the premium 18 Pro models were launched in the last days of the ​company's fiscal 2026.

stories.title: Bomb threats trigger security alerts at airports across Europe
summary: Warsaw Modlin Airport temporarily closed after a bomb threat involving a flight from London, according to the airport.

Polish airport closes after bomb threat involving flight from London Warsaw-Modlin Airport in Poland was closed until further notice after a flight from London was diverted there following a reported bomb threat, the airport said in a statement.
On Monday, a Wizz Air flight from London to Sofia was diverted to Budapest following a bomb threat.

stories.title: Experts urge regular phone updates amid surge in WhatsApp account hijacking
summary: Cybersecurity experts warn that phone software needs to be kept up to date to prevent security breaches amid a rise in WhatsApp account takeovers and fraud attempts.

Attackers can hijack WhatsApp accounts, mimic the compromised account holders’ chatting styles and send deceptive messages to people in their circles, pretending to be in urgent need of loans via bank transfers.

Gunduzgil stated that the security vulnerabilities leading to account hijacking are not exclusive to either Android or iOS, but recent reports indicate that iOS devices running outdated software exhibit these vulnerabilities.

stories.title: ‘Primetime’ digital release: Where to stream Robert Pattinson’s new thriller
summary: A24’s thriller Primetime, starring Robert Pattinson as former television presenter Chris Hansen, is now available to watch at home following its theatrical release.
The film arrives on premium video on demand platforms on November 3, allowing viewers to rent or purchase it digitally.
Although Primetime is now available for digital purchase and rental, a subscription streaming release date has not been announced.

stories.title: Johnny Depp reveals one condition for returning to ‘Pirates of the Caribbean 6’
summary: Johnny Depp has opened up about the possibility of reprising his iconic role as Captain Jack Sparrow in Pirates of the Caribbean 6, revealing that he would consider returning for one important reason: giving the franchise a satisfying conclusion.
Bruckheimer previously expressed optimism about Depp reprising the role.
Bruckheimer has also publicly voiced support for Depp’s involvement.

summary: One would readily go along with the view that Gandhi makes for a great candidate to don the mantle of prime minister and also restore its prestige.
No Indian prime minister with a clear majority in parliament has offered to resign other than Nehru.

stories.title: Indian national killed after 2 helicopters collide in Nepal's Mount Everest region
summary: An Indian national was killed and a New Zealander injured after two helicopters collided as they prepared to land in Nepal’s Mount Everest region on Tuesday, authorities said.
Fishtail Air said in a statement that its helicopter was carrying passengers who had been rescued from the Everest region when it crashed while landing.
The Indian and the New Zealander on board were tourists, a Fishtail official said, while a Dynasty Air official said its helicopter was carrying only cargo.

stories.title: US intelligence sharing has fractured under Trump, officials say
summary: Turf wars and reduced cooperation The problems inside the intelligence community started last year amid significant cuts to national security agencies, including the ODNI and the CIA, as Trump moved to remove or sideline officials he viewed as disloyal.

Some analysts who remain at the intelligence agencies are now careful not to write assessments at odds with White House’s views for fear of political retaliation, two former officials and a current US official said.

The National Intelligence Council, which for decades has been a key resource for officials and lawmakers making foreign policy decisions, lost its main author when the CIA stopped writing into the assessments last year.

stories.title: Dar reaffirms govt's commitment to public relief in meeting with JI delegation
summary: On September 3, the government and JI agreed to establish technical committees to examine proposals for reducing the petroleum levy and fuel prices.
On September 12, JI chief announced a long march towards Islamabad for September 20, warning that the party would intensify its campaign if the government did not abolish the levy.

The JI chief then gave the government 10 days to abolish the petroleum levy and provide meaningful relief to the inflation-hit public, warning that his party would resume its long march towards Islamabad in mid-November if its demands were not met.

stories.title: Australia's Glenn Maxwell calls time on international career
summary: Explosive batsman Glenn Maxwell announced his international retirement Tuesday after being overlooked for Australia’s upcoming Twenty20 series against England.
The mercurial 38-year-old, who had not played a Test since 2017, called time on his one-day career last year but kept the door open for T20s.
He has not been picked since the World Cup in Sri Lanka in February, with selectors bypassing him for a series against Bangladesh in June.

stories.title: Zohran Mamdani trolls JD Vance’s New York City boasts with viral subway meme
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has responded to Vice President JD Vance’s claims about the Trump administration’s achievements in New York with a brief video that has attracted widespread attention online.
Vance shared a post on X on Monday, November 2, listing what he described as the administration’s accomplishments for the city and state.

He ended the post by writing, “We got your back, New York!” However, the claims faced scrutiny after an X Community Note challenged several figures, arguing that some investments were nationwide pledges rather than New York-specific results.

stories.title: Maaz Sadaqat, Hasan Nawaz named in Pakistan Shaheens squad for Rising Stars Asia Cup
summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board announced the squad on Tuesday, with the Shaheens set to defend the title they won in the previous 50-over edition in 2023.
Ahmed Daniyal was part of the Shaheens side that won the previous T20 edition, playing a key role as the team clinched the title against Bangladesh A in a Super Over.
The Shaheens will be aiming to retain their title against a field that includes several of the region’s emerging sides, with a meeting against India A among the key fixtures in the group stage.

stories.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after collision
summary: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel died on Tuesday as a result of injuries he suffered in a sickening collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper in a Spanish second division match.
Andorra also sent their "most sincere condolences" to De Miguel's family, team-mates and Tenerife.
"We share in your grief," wrote Tolon, offering her "deepest condolences to (De Miguel's) family and loved ones", as well as Tenerife, the players and staff.

stories.title: Paris Jackson seeks $600m trust fund from Michael Jackson's estate
summary: Paris Jackson has petitioned a Los Angeles probate court to order a $600 million distribution from her late father Michael Jackson's estate to the Michael Jackson Family Trust, arguing that the fund remains unfunded more than 17 years after his death.
According to legal documents obtained by TheWrap, Paris claims her father intended for his children, including brothers Prince and Bigi Jackson, to receive income from the trust when they turned 21.
The petition also raises concerns about the timing of future distributions, noting that Michael Jackson intended for his children to begin receiving trust principal when they turned 30.

stories.title: PHC sends petitions challenging detentions of Afridi, others to CJ to form larger bench

stories.title: Pakistan offers to share energy crisis management experience with Bangladesh
summary: Titumir shared the steps taken by Bangladesh to ensure fuel security and address emerging challenges, saying the current crisis had brought energy security to the forefront of policymaking.
Both sides stressed the importance of continued engagement and sharing experiences to address common energy challenges and build greater resilience against future global supply disruptions.

stories.title: US and Iran review draft proposal to end war, Qatar says
summary: The United States and Iran are committed to mediation efforts and are reviewing proposals aimed at bridging their differences, Qatar said on Tuesday.
Qatar said that both the United States and Iran remained committed to mediation efforts and were reviewing proposals put forward by mediators.

"Mediators are working hard to narrow gaps between Tehran and Washington," the senior Iranian official said, after Qatari mediators travelled to Tehran on Monday night for talks on a version of a draft US-Iran deal that has been under negotiation for the past eight days.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi agree to enhance cooperation in media, culture, tourism
summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar and Saudi Ambassador to Pakistan Dr Rajeh Tami Albugamy on Tuesday agreed to further strengthen cooperation between the two brotherly countries in the fields of information, broadcasting, media, culture, and public relations.
The minister said Pakistan-Saudi Arabia relations were reaching new heights, with vast opportunities for expanding cooperation in media, culture, drama, music, tourism, and people-to-people contacts.

Read: Saudi envoy visits Dino Valley, highlights Pakistan's tourism potential The minister also proposed exchanges of delegations comprising writers, poets, artists, musicians, media professionals and digital content creators to strengthen cultural and professional linkages.

stories.title: US signals progress in Iran talks to avert flare-up
summary: US President Donald Trump signaled progress on Tuesday in talks with Iran to avoid a return to war, as Tehran reported “intensive” exchanges while offering to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under strict conditions.

Beijing supports Tehran in “safeguarding its own sovereignty and security,” Foreign Minister Wang Yi told Ali Bagheri, deputy secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, according to a Chinese statement.

Bagheri told Wang that “Tehran’s stance on defending its national security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity remains unchanged, and that Iran will make no compromises in this regard,” state TV reported.

stories.title: Sindh CM reviews WB-funded projects worth $3.8bn
summary: He was chairing a high-level portfolio review meeting with World Bank Country Director Bolormaa Amgaabazar at CM House to take stock of implementation, financial progress, procurement and outstanding challenges across the province.
The $240 million Second Karachi Water and Sewerage Services Improvement Project (KWSSIP-2) was reviewed with particular attention to the K-IV associated facilities.

The Karachi Mobility Project, which includes the Yellow Line Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) corridor and associated road infrastructure, was reviewed with particular attention to the Jam Sadiq Bridge and bus depots.
